source_brief.marketing_message: Stop overpaying brokers — own your trades

campaign_summary: Three bold concepts challenging traders to cut unnecessary costs, regain control, and assert decisive command over their investments.

concepts.name: Profit Overhead
concepts.strategic_idea: Highlight the advantage of retaining earnings by cutting out excessive brokerage fees.

visual_direction.description: sharp image of a gleaming silver guillotine blade poised above a stack of coins, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting

copy_package.headline: Cut Brokerage Fees Today
copy_package.subheadline: Retain more of your earnings with Profit Overhead.
copy_package.body: Discover the advantage of minimising brokerage fees and maximising your potential returns. Profit Overhead empowers you to take control of your trades and retain more of your hard-earned capital.
copy_package.disclaimer: Investing involves risks. You may lose more than your initial investment. Ensure you understand the risks involved.

midjourney_prompt_pack.prompt_text: dramatic interplay of light and shadow on steel surfaces, suggesting precision and decisiveness. No logo, no UI, no readable text, no watermark.
sleek, abstract form in shiny metal with sharp cut edges, minimalist and impactful. No numbers, no letters.
sharply defined silhouette of a precision tool at rest on a polished black surface. Photographic, no UI, no text on the object.

concepts.name: Master Your Market
concepts.strategic_idea: Empower traders with unparalleled control over their financial strategies.

visual_direction.description: crisp, linear patterns of intersecting light planes, creating a sense of order and precision

copy_package.headline: Take Charge of Your Trades
copy_package.subheadline: Gain control over your trading strategies.
copy_package.body: Join 'Master Your Market' to enhance your trading approach. Understand your costs and make informed decisions without overpaying. Empower yourself with the tools to navigate the market with confidence.
copy_package.disclaimer: Trading involves risk. You may lose more than your initial investment. Ensure you understand the risks involved.

concepts.name: Expose & Reclaim
concepts.strategic_idea: Inspire traders to uncover hidden costs and win back their rightful earnings.

visual_direction.description: a macro shot of a coin with a stark division between aged and polished surfaces, symbolizing discovery and recovery

copy_package.headline: Expose & Reclaim Costs
copy_package.subheadline: Uncover hidden fees and reclaim earnings.
copy_package.body: Discover how transparent trading can help you regain control over your investments. Learn to identify and eliminate unnecessary broker charges that eat into your profits.
copy_package.disclaimer: Investing carries risk. You may get back less than you invest.
